NIVEDITHA K T

US Healthcare Operations | Product Owner | Claims Testing | Quality Management

Email: niveditha. niveditha.13kt@gmail.com | Contact: 9741477606 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/niveditha-kt-620385a8 | Bengaluru, India

CSPO-certified US Healthcare professional with 10+ years of experience across Product Ownership, healthcare operations, claims testing, revenue cycle management, patient accounting, prior authorization, API/microservices delivery and quality assurance. Experienced in day-to-day delivery governance, stakeholder and partner coordination, operational reporting, quality management, process improvement,

capacity planning support and Agile execution. Strong background in claims and billing workflows, SOP and process documentation, RCA/CAPA support, team mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.

CORE SKILLS US Healthcare Revenue Cycle, Claims Testing, Patient Accounting, Prior Authorization, Claims/Billing Workflows, Benefit Configuration Exposure, Claims Adjudication Operations & Delivery Day-to-day Operations, Internal Metrics, TAT, Productivity, Utilization, Capacity Planning, Forecasting, Resource Planning, SLA Management Quality & Process Quality Metrics, Defect Triage, RCA, CAPA, SOPs, Training Material, Process Improvement, Operational Excellence Leadership & Stakeholders People Management, Team Leadership, Coaching & Mentoring, Employee Engagement, Partner Management, Conflict Management Product & Agile Product Ownership, Backlog Management, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Agile Ceremonies, Project Management Tools JIRA, Azure DevOps, Rally, Confluence, ServiceNow, Postman, SoapUI, Balsamiq, RQM, Excel, PowerPoint PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AS PRODUCT OWNER

Technical Product Owner | LTIMindtree, Bengaluru | Dec 2024 - Present

Project: Premera - CIRRIS Application Modernization

Manage product requirements and modernization scope by collaborating with business, product, engineering and QA stakeholders.

Document functional, non-functional and operational requirements in Azure DevOps; create user stories with clear acceptance criteria and traceability.

Facilitate grooming, sprint planning and retrospectives; support sprint execution, delivery tracking and dependency management.

Support day-to-day delivery governance by reviewing blockers, delivery risks, quality observations and release readiness.

Prepare process flows, SOP-style knowledge material and business demonstration content for modernized workflows.

Coordinate work allocation and sprint capacity planning to optimize resource utilization and delivery commitments.

Mentor cross-functional team members through onboarding, knowledge transfer, coaching and performance-improvement support.

Partner with business teams on process updates, scope clarifications, training support and stakeholder alignment.

Project: Optum - Prior Authorization / OPS

Gathered and managed requirements for healthcare APIs, microservice endpoints and prior authorization workflows using Rally.

Validated features and defect fixes using Postman, ensuring alignment with business requirements and operational expectations.

Collaborated across teams to manage dependencies, improve requirement clarity and meet sprint commitments.

Supported incident and problem-ticket tracking through command center and ServiceNow, contributing to operational stability and TAT management.

Participated in quality reviews, defect analysis, RCA and CAPA discussions to reduce recurring issues.

Assisted function-level reporting by consolidating feature status, blockers, dependencies and validation outcomes.

Collaborated with leadership to monitor delivery progress, productivity, quality observations, utilization and operational KPIs.

Product Owner | Oracle Cerner, Bengaluru | Nov 2021 - Nov 2024

Project: HDXTS Medical Services

Owned healthcare API and microservice requirements; translated business needs into product, functional, technical and non-functional requirements.

Created and prioritized JIRA stories with clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end traceability in Confluence.

Acted as liaison across business, engineering, QA and operations teams to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

Validated service functionality using SoapUI and supported quality management through defect review and corrective-action follow-up.

Prepared UI navigation and accessibility requirements aligned with W3C guidelines; created application designs using Balsamiq.

Documented data-submission rules based on CMS-related business rules and workflow expectations.

Supported workforce planning, resource forecasting, employee engagement, knowledge sharing and team collaboration initiatives.

Mentored team members on healthcare workflows, tools and Agile practices; supported onboarding, coaching and skill development.

Senior Test Automation Engineer | Cerner Corporation, Bengaluru | Mar 2021 - Nov 2021

Project: Revenue Cycle

Led functional and automated testing across charge services, account management, billing/claims and transaction-posting workflows.

Created test plans aligned with client workflows across PowerChart, PathNet, FirstNet and Revenue Cycle modules.

Performed claims testing, defect triage, RCA support and closure tracking to improve quality metrics and reduce recurring defects.

Conducted periodic performance testing to validate response times and support operational stability.

Created configuration and workflow documentation covering charge services, account management, claims and transaction posting.

Mentored junior team members, coordinated testing activities, provided performance feedback and supported skill development.

Supported process improvements to enhance productivity, documentation quality and release confidence.

Test Automation Engineer | Cerner Corporation, Bengaluru | May 2018 - Feb 2021

Project: Revenue Cycle

Created functional test plans for billing/claims workflows and validated end-to-end revenue cycle scenarios.

Automated Revenue Cycle billing workflow test cases, improving regression coverage and testing efficiency.

Validated defects and documented evidence using RQM, ensuring traceability and audit-ready documentation.

Supported fortnightly performance testing and collaborated with teams to track response-time observations and quality trends.

Worked with stakeholders to clarify workflow expectations, improve test coverage and maintain delivery quality.

Test Analyst | Cerner Corporation, Bengaluru | Jun 2015 - Apr 2018

Project: Revenue Cycle

Performed manual and UI testing for patient account applications and billing workflows in revenue cycle management.

Documented test plans, execution evidence and workflow observations for claims and billing scenarios.

Built strong domain knowledge in US healthcare operations, patient accounting, billing, claims processing and quality assurance.

HEALTHCARE DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Collaborated with team members and business stakeholders to resolve defects and support timely delivery.

Revenue Cycle Management: Charge services, account management, billing/claims, transaction posting and patient accounting.

Claims Testing: Billing-claims workflow validation, defect evidence, regression testing and end-to-end scenario coverage.

Benefit Configuration Exposure: Validation of claims/billing outcomes against configured workflow rules and business requirements.

Operations Support: Incident tracking, problem-ticket coordination, delivery-metrics review, SOP documentation and training support.

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) | M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore | 2012 - 2015

Discover AI for Leaders in Healthcare (2026) | FHIR - Resource Concepts (2026) | Agentic AI and AI Agents: A Primer for Leaders (2025) | Generative AI: Prompt Engineering Basics (2025) | Leading SAFe 4.5 LiveLessons (2024) | Certified Scrum Product Owner - CSPO (2024) | Agile Product Owner Role: Techniques (2021) | SAFe: Prep for PI Planning Workshop (2021) | Product Owner/Analyst Required Training (2021)

Strong written and verbal communication with experience in stakeholder demos, status reporting and cross-team coordination.

Comfortable working with distributed teams, US healthcare stakeholders and flexible shifts.

Strong planning, organizing, decision-making, adaptability, change management and relationship-building capabilities.

Experience supporting employee engagement, retention-focused team collaboration, conflict resolution and performance improvement.

Proficient in Excel reporting and PowerPoint presentations for operational and leadership communication.
